questions.stem: At approximately what altitude does the International Space Station (ISS) orbit Earth?
questions.explanation: The International Space Station orbits Earth at an altitude of approximately 400 km. It has been continuously occupied since 2000 and serves as a microgravity research laboratory for scientific experiments.

questions.stem: Who was the first human to travel into space?
questions.explanation: Yuri Gagarin, a Soviet cosmonaut, became the first human to travel into space on 12 April 1961 aboard Vostok 1. He completed one orbit of the Earth, and the flight lasted approximately 108 minutes.
